6 days Kerala tour with two nights in Munnar

Kochi · Munnar · Thekkady · Alleppey · 6 days

6 days South India tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

The five-day Kerala route with a full day added in the tea hills, so Munnar is a stay rather than a stop.

At a glance

What makes this one worth it

  • Two nights in Munnar's tea country
  • Eravikulam National Park and a short boat on Kundala Lake
  • Periyar Lake boat safari and a spice plantation
  • Kalaripayattu martial arts show
  • A private houseboat night on the Alleppey backwaters

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Kochi

    Airport pickup and check-in. If you land early, Fort Kochi, Mattancherry Palace and the Jewish Synagogue, then a walk along the waterfront.

  2. Day 2

    Kochi to Munnar

    Up into the hills through spice plantations and small towns, with stops at the waterfalls on the way.

  3. Day 3

    A full day in Munnar

    The Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Eravikulam National Park for the Nilgiri tahr, and a short boat ride on Kundala Lake.

  4. Day 4

    Munnar to Thekkady

    Through tea country into the forest around Periyar. Kalaripayattu show in the evening.

  5. Day 5

    Periyar Lake and onto the houseboat

    Morning boat safari on Periyar Lake and a spice plantation walk — cardamom, pepper, cinnamon — then to Alleppey to board your houseboat.

  6. Day 6

    Back to Kochi airport

    Breakfast on board and the drive to Kochi airport.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car and driver throughout
  • 4 nights hotel with breakfast
  • 1 night private houseboat with all meals
  • Guided sightseeing
  • Periyar boat safari
  • Spice plantation visit
  • Kalaripayattu show
  • Tolls, parking and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Flights to and from Kochi
  • Lunch and dinner on land
  • Park and museum tickets
  • Tips

Questions people ask

How is this different from the 5-day tour?
The same route with one more night in Munnar, so the hill day is not squeezed into a travel day.
Can we add a beach at the end?
Yes. Two nights at Kovalam or Marari fit after the houseboat.
